title: AC1018 TABLE common-header state rollback
scope: Preserve caller-visible common-header flag caches when the generated AC1018 TABLE direct codec fails after common-header emission starts.

finding.before: At generated allocation-failure offset 7, DRW_Table::encodeDwg preserved staged body and handle buffers but encodeDwgCommon had changed plotFlags from the caller's value 2 to its derived value 0.
finding.after: The TABLE encoder snapshots all seven common-header flag caches that encodeDwgCommon may derive and restores them unless body and handle buffers are both committed.
finding.profile: Generated AC1018 direct TABLE codec only; public dwgRW::writeTable remains refused.

control.input: In-memory 2x2 AC1018 TABLE grid with one text-style override; plotFlags is seeded to 2 before each injected failure.

assertions: Seeded body and handle buffers and bit counts remain unchanged.
The caller's plotFlags value remains 2 after each failed call.
The same TABLE object and buffers retry successfully and match clean calibration bytes.
Successful retry retains the derived plotFlags value 0.

control.fixture: No DWG/DXF fixture file was created or committed.

limitations: Generated direct-codec failure/retry evidence only; it does not qualify a physical AC1018 TABLE source or native behavior.
The compound *T graph, outer writer transaction, independent readback, and public TABLE output gate remain open.
